name: Amazon Kiro
official_status_notes: Proprietary AWS IDE (spec-driven development). Not open source; verify current availability/pricing on the official site.
best_for: Developers who want a spec-first, plan-heavy agent workflow with a full IDE.
strengths: Spec-driven development, property-based tests, parallel agents, open source, AWS-hosted.
weaknesses: New-ish product; feature velocity fast but young.
hardware_requirements: IDE is Code OSS based; lightweight.
